notes.title: Slug Disco @ Tokyo Game Shows 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Slug Disco will be returning to Tokyo Game Show from September 25th to the 28th!

The Ember Guardian will be available to play in the Select Indie 80 section of the venue, and we will have 6 more games to play over in the indie area of the show.

The games on show will be:

[list]
[*] Adapt
[*] Green Again
[*] Horticular (with a surprise!)
[*] Strange Seed
[*] Ecosystem
[*] Primordial Empire
[/list]

If you're at the show please come say hello to me (Dan) and Hei Man :)

notes.title: Pathogenic Playtest Starting Now!
notes.content: [p]Exciting news! Pathogenic has been cooking for a while and is now ready to be tested out by you! [/p][p][/p][p]This is your chance to be among the first to dive into the microscopic world, build your own parasite, and help us shape the future of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's in the Playtest?[/h3][list][*][p][b]3 Unique Pathogens:[/b] Master three different starting parasites, each with its own distinct playstyle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 Organs to Conquer:[/b] Fight your way through the Skin, Stomach, and Liver, battling unique immune cells and bosses in each biome.[/p][/*][*][p][b]50+ Upgrades:[/b] Experiment with a huge arsenal of over 50 organelles and mutations to discover powerful, synergistic builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Metaprogression:[/b] Get a taste of the permanent upgrade system by collecting Plasmids and ramping up the difficulty with the Antibiotics system.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]This is An Early Beta[/h3][p]Please remember that the game is still deep in development. You will likely encounter bugs, imbalances, or unfinished systems. Your feedback during this critical phase is what helps us squash those bugs and make the game better for everyone at launch.[/p][p][/p][h3]We Need Your Feedback![/h3][p]Your opinion, whether it's positive or negative, is incredibly valuable. Once you've had a chance to play, please tell us what could be improved and what you'd like to see in the final game.[/p][p]You can leave feedback in any of the following places:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]Community Hub[/b] right here on Steam[/p][/*][*][p]Our official [b][url="https://discord.gg/vKEek8PBA4"]Discord Server[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p]This anonymous [b][url="https://forms.gle/wHMLwSysFioRvRM8A"]Feedback Form[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your help and support. We're excited to hear what you think![/p][p]— Aberrant Labs[/p]
